newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiichi, Yakult ask only after media report.
newsitem.headline: Daiichi, Yakult ask only after media report.

text.p: Shares of Daiichi Pharmaceutical Co Ltd and Yakult Honsha Co Ltd were ask only early on Tuesday morning after a newspaper report on the anti-cancer drug they sell.
By 0030 GMT, Daiichi shares were ask only at 1,950 yen against Monday's close of 2,020.
Yakult shares were ask only at 1,220 yen, against Monday's close of 1,260 yen.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun newspaper said on Tuesday that at least 24 people who were treated with the anti-cancer drug irinotecan hydrochloride, sold by Daiichi Pharmaceutical, died due to symptoms believed to be linked to the drug's side effects.
Daiichi started selling the drug in April 1994 and it had been used by about 3,100 patients by March 1997, the paper said.
The drug has also sold by Yakult since April 1994 but data on the use of Yakult-sold drug was not available, the paper said.
